info.title: MEMS tenant-aware election API
info.description: Anonymous election reads are scoped by municipality slug. Municipal administrators are restricted to their stored assignment, including public routes. Municipality management is Super Admin only. Sign in using /api/auth/login and Identity cookies; fetch /api/auth/csrf before login and again afterward. Every modifying request requires X-CSRF-TOKEN. PUT, DELETE and media changes also require the current quoted ETag in If-Match. No ballot selections are accepted or stored.
